messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Had to move from where I was born/brought up just to be rid of the hassle!

output.original_text: Had to move from where I was born/brought up just to be rid of the hassle!
output.joy: I happily moved away from where I was born, finally free from all that hassle!
output.sadness: I had to leave my birthplace behind, just to escape the burdensome hassle.
output.fear: I felt I had no choice but to move from my birthplace, fearing the hassle would never end!
output.anger: I was forced to leave my hometown, just to escape the endless hassle that made me furious!
output.surprise: Can you believe I had to move all the way from my hometown just to get away from that hassle?
output.disgust: I had to move from my childhood home, just to escape that disgusting hassle!
